bs.label: The fair value of Series A preferred units.  The Preferred Units are entitled to a preferential quarterly cash distribution and automatically convert into common shares at a certain date.  Preferred units may be redeemed at a certain date for common units or cash equal to the issue price plus a premium paid out in common units.  The holder also has certain rights to force redemption or conversion upon the occurrence of certain extraordinary events.  Holders of the Preferred Units have no voting rights, except that approval of a majority of the Preferred Units is needed to approve any amendment to the Agreement of Limited Partnership that would result in (i) any increase in the size of the class of Preferred Units, (ii) any alteration or change to the rights, preferences, privileges, duties, or obligations of the Preferred Units or (iii) any other matter that would adversely affect the rights or preferences of the Preferred Units, including in relation to other classes of partnership interests.
